title: Energy, Heat & Temperature
summary: Energy changes form but is never lost. Heat flows from hot to cold by conduction, convection and radiation, and good design can keep chai hot, water cool and homes comfortable.

ib.statementOfInquiry: Understanding how energy is transformed and how heat is transferred helps us design solutions that use energy more sustainably.

factual: What is the difference between heat and temperature?
How do conduction, convection and radiation transfer heat?
conceptual: Why does energy seem to 'disappear' when it is actually conserved?
How can we control the flow of heat?
debatable: Should cities make cool roofs compulsory?
Is air conditioning a solution or a problem in a warming world?
